title: Identify schools that are either exclusively virtual or primarily virtual,
question: Identify schools that are either exclusively virtual or primarily virtual, located in the county with the highest number of closed schools, and have a difference greater than 50 between their K-12 enrollment and ages 5–17 enrollment. For these schools, return their name, city, full street address, and their rank within the county based on average math SAT scores.

prediction.sql:
WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM schools
    WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_047" AS name,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        s."XCL_048" AS street_address,
        s."XCL_045" AS county,
        t."XCL_037" AS avg_math
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    LEFT JOIN satscores t ON s."XCL_041" = t."XCL_030"
    WHERE s."XCL_045" = (SELECT county FROM top_county)
      AND s."XCL_076" IN ('F', 'P')
      AND ABS(f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") > 50
)
SELECT name, city, street_address,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_math DESC) AS rank
FROM filtered

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM schools
    WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        s."XCL_047" AS name,
        s."XCL_050" AS city,
        s."XCL_048" AS street_address,
        s."XCL_045" AS county,
        t."XCL_037" AS avg_math
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
    LEFT JOIN satscores t ON s."XCL_041" = t."XCL_030"
    WHERE s."XCL_045" = (SELECT county FROM top_county)
      AND s."XCL_076" IN ('F', 'P')
      AND ABS(f."XCL_019" - f."XCL_024") > 50
)
SELECT name, city, street_address,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY county ORDER BY avg_math DESC) AS rank
FROM filtered

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT "XCL_045" AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM schools
  WHERE "XCL_044" = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY "XCL_045"
),
top_county AS (
  SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    s."XCL_043" AS name,
    s."XCL_046" AS city,
    s."XCL_042" AS street_address,
    s."XCL_045" AS county,
    AVG(t."XCL_038") AS avg_math
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
  LEFT JOIN satscores t ON s."XCL_041" = t."XCL_030"
  WHERE s."XCL_045" = (SELECT county FROM top_county)
    AND f."XCL_002" IN ('Exclusively Virtual', 'Primarily Virtual')
    AND ABS(f."XCL_005" - f."XCL_006") > 50
  GROUP BY s."XCL_041"
)
SELECT name, city, street_address,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_math DESC) AS rank
FROM filtered

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH county_closed AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_049 AS county,
        COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.XCL_048 = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_049
    ORDER BY closed_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
target_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_041 AS cds,
        s.XCL_042 AS name,
        s.XCL_043 AS city,
        s.XCL_044 || ' ' || s.XCL_045 AS full_address,
        s.XCL_049 AS county,
        f.XCL_013 AS k12_enrollment,
        f.XCL_014 AS ages_5_17_enrollment
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
    WHERE s.XCL_049 = (SELECT county FROM county_closed)
      AND (s.XCL_047 = 'Virtual' OR s.XCL_047 = 'Primarily Virtual')
      AND (f.XCL_013 - f.XCL_014) > 50
),
ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        ts.cds,
        ts.name,
        ts.city,
        ts.full_address,
        ts.county,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.county ORDER BY COALESCE(sa.XCL_035, 0) DESC) AS math_rank
    FROM target_schools ts
    LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON ts.cds = sa.XCL_030
)
SELECT 
    name,
    city,
    full_address,
    math_rank
FROM ranked_schools
